result.title: Interpreting Diffusion Model Activations in Natural Language
result.summary: Interpreting the intermediate activations of diffusion models (DMs) is key to understanding how they generate images. Existing interpretability methods for DMs provide limited support for open-ended interrogation, making it difficult to extract human-interpretable insights. We extend LatentQA, the task of answering natural-language questions about Large Language Model activations, to DM activations. We introduce the Diffusion-specific Activation Oracle (DAO), which translates DM activations into natural-language answers to open-ended questions about the ongoing generation. Our experiments show that DAO can effectively describe the content of the final image from activations at early denoising steps. Additionally, we demonstrate that DAO captures the structure of the DM's activation space well enough to steer image generation toward target attributes. Furthermore, we show that attribution patching through DAO identifies DM components that contribute to visual attributes specified in natural language. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/yamanoko/dao/tree/main}{here}.

AI.brief_summary: 把 LatentQA 从 LLM 激活扩展到扩散模型，提出 DAO：用自然语言问答解读去噪过程中的中间激活，并据此描述最终图像内容、引导生成属性、以及通过 attribution patching 定位相关组件。
AI.relevance_reason: 「用开放问题读出中间激活内容」的方法线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要的视觉细节，以及不同深度/步数的状态可解码性差异；但对象是图像生成而非 VLM 推理，迁移性需阅读原文确认。
